title: Pins
description: Every pin of a part, grouped into headers, sockets or rows of pads.

headers.description: Headers, sockets or rows of pads.

header.description: One header, socket or row of pads.

id.description: Id used by pins in this file.

label.description: The name on the board or in the source, for example J2.

type.description: header: pins sticking out. socket: holes for pins. pads: solder pads.

pitch_mm.description: Distance between neighbouring pins in millimetres.

section.description: Heading on a web page source.

edges.description: Where the header runs on the board, in pin order. Several runs when it wraps around a module.

edge.description: Board edge, or inside for a header away from the edges.

run.description: Only for inside: the direction the pins run.

first.description: Which end of the run its first position is at.

row1.description: Only for 2-row headers: the side row 1 lies on.

order.description: Sorts runs that share an edge (top to bottom, left to right).

section.description: Heading on a web page source.

id.description: Readable id, unique in this part, for example gpio21 or gnd-2.

index.description: Position in the row, from 1, in the order of the cited pin table.

chip_name.description: The pin's name on the chip, for example GPIO21.

module_pad.description: The pad's name on the module, for example IO21.

board_label.description: What is printed next to the pin.

label_aliases.description: Other names people use for this pin.

arduino.description: The pin number in Arduino code, or a name like A0.

direction.description: io, in, out, power, ground or nc (not connected).

voltage.description: The pin's logic or supply voltage in volts.

five_v_tolerant.description: True when the pin survives 5 V input.

strapping.description: For pins read at reset to choose how the chip starts.

role.description: What it chooses, for example boot-mode.

must_be.description: The level a normal start needs, when the source states one. Leave out when any level works or the source doesn't say.

safe.description: ok: free to use. caution: works with care (see note or gotchas). avoid: don't use.

cites.description: Where these facts come from (names, functions, voltage may be on different pages).

function.description: One thing a pin can do.

signal.description: The signal name, for example SDA or ADC1_CH0.

default.description: True when this is the pin's usual job for that function.
